myimg-ai.seoDescription: MyIMG AI is an 18+ image and video generator with face swap, undress effects and one-time credit packs. Compare plans, free limits and alternatives.
myimg-ai.introduction:
MyIMG AI is an adults-only image and video generation platform that bundles a large set of NSFW-oriented tools into one web app. The core workflow is upload or generate: you add a photo, choose a preset such as undress, face swap, lingerie or a body and pose adjustment, add an optional prompt, and generate a new image. A fine-tune panel lets you change clothing, breast size, body type, pose and visual style, with realistic, anime, Ghibli, 3D and Polaroid looks among the options.

The same account also covers video features: image-to-video animation, video face swap, dance and body-motion templates, a clothes changer and a comic maker. Paid plans advertise access to every tool, HD output without a watermark, priority processing, a commercial license and, on higher tiers, longer video processing.

Pricing is credit-based. MyIMG sells one-time packs instead of recurring subscriptions, and the pricing page says credits never expire. Premium features, however, are valid for 30 to 365 days depending on the plan, so a large credit balance can outlast the features you bought it for. Uploaded and generated content is deleted within 24 hours, and the site says it keeps no backups. The service is strictly 18+, and users must have consent from anyone whose photo they upload.
myimg-ai.verdict: MyIMG AI packs an unusually broad set of adult image and video tools into one credit-based account, and its one-time pricing avoids subscription lock-in. Output is fast and the privacy policy is unusually explicit, but premium features expire while credits do not, refund terms conflict, and the NSFW focus rules out mainstream work. It suits consenting adults who value variety over polish.

myimg-ai.pricingSummary: MyIMG AI uses one-time credit packs rather than subscriptions. Basic costs $9.99 for 1,050 credits, Standard $49.99 for 6,250 credits, Premium $99.99 for 15,000 credits and Unlimit $399.99 for 15,000 credits with the broadest access. A limited free plan is available. Credits are advertised as non-expiring, but premium features last only 30 to 365 days; the 30-day refund policy is stated with several different usage thresholds, so confirm eligibility before buying.

faqs.question: Is MyIMG AI free?
faqs.answer: There is a free plan with limited trial credits and restricted features, including a 3-second cap on generated videos. Most tools require a paid credit pack after the free allowance is used.

faqs.question: Do MyIMG AI credits expire?
faqs.answer: The pricing page says purchased credits never expire. Premium features such as longer video processing and priority processing are valid for 30 to 365 days depending on the plan, so feature access can end while credits remain.

faqs.question: Is MyIMG AI a subscription?
faqs.answer: No. The plans on the pricing page are one-time purchases with no recurring billing or auto-renewal. You buy a credit balance and use it until it runs out.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund from MyIMG AI?
faqs.answer: MyIMG advertises a 30-day refund policy, but the page states different conditions in different places: less than 20% of credits used, fewer than 10 uses, or at least 80% of credits unused. Refunds are limited to first-time customers and one per account, so confirm eligibility with support before buying.

faqs.question: What video lengths does MyIMG AI support?
faqs.answer: Video generation is capped at 3 seconds on the free plan, 5 seconds on Basic and 8 seconds on Premium and Unlimit. Paid plans advertise video face swaps of up to 60 seconds.

faqs.question: Is MyIMG AI private and safe to use?
faqs.answer: The site says uploads and generated results are deleted within 24 hours, are not used for model training and are not backed up. It is strictly for adults 18 and over, and you must have consent from anyone whose photo you upload.

ai-smut-writer.seoTitle: AI Smut Writer Review: Pricing & Alternatives
ai-smut-writer.seoDescription: AI Smut Writer is an 18+ AI erotic fiction generator with Story and Chat modes. Compare free daily credits, Casual to Infinity pricing and alternatives.
ai-smut-writer.introduction:
AI Smut Writer is an adults-only AI fiction platform for writing personalized erotic stories. You start by describing a scenario, setting or character, then either draft a structured story in Story Mode or role-play interactively in Chat Mode. The Story Mode editor can continue a scene, rewrite a passage, adjust tone and regenerate sections without starting over.

Around the writing workspace, the site adds character creation, plot brainstorming and editing assistance. Character tools build dossiers covering appearance, personality and interests; plot tools suggest twists and conflicts; editing tools revise pacing and detail. The result is closer to a dedicated fiction workspace than a generic chatbot, although output quality still depends heavily on the prompt and the selected model.

The free tier gives six credits refreshed daily and does not require a card. Paid tiers are displayed on the pricing page as $7, $20 or $125 per month with annual charges of $90, $250 and $1,500, and they raise the daily credit allowance to 50, 220 or 1,500. Higher tiers also advertise more chat models, image generation and remixing, scene visualizations and video tools. Credits refresh daily rather than accumulating, and the terms state that all payments are final and non-refundable, so trial the free tier before committing.
ai-smut-writer.verdict: AI Smut Writer is a focused, easy-to-use workspace for adults who want custom erotic fiction without drafting from scratch. Story Mode, Chat Mode and the character tools cover planning through revision, and six free daily credits make it cheap to test. Paid plans are shown as annual charges, credits do not roll over, and payments are non-refundable, so subscribe only after trialing.

faqs.question: Is AI Smut Writer free?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is a free tier with six credits refreshed daily and no credit card required. It is enough to test the writing workflow, but heavy use requires a paid plan.

faqs.question: How much does AI Smut Writer cost?
faqs.answer: The pricing page displays annual charges: Casual is $90 per year (about $7 per month), Creator $250 per year (about $20 per month) and Infinity $1,500 per year (about $125 per month). Each tier raises the daily credit allowance.

faqs.question: Do AI Smut Writer credits roll over?
faqs.answer: No. Credits refresh daily up to each plan's allowance instead of accumulating, and the terms say unused credits may expire. Plan your sessions around the daily allowance rather than stockpiling credits.

faqs.question: Can I cancel AI Smut Writer and get a refund?
faqs.answer: You can cancel at any time to stop future billing, but the terms say all payments are final and non-refundable, including subscriptions and credit purchases. Cancelling does not refund the current billing period.

faqs.question: What can I create with AI Smut Writer?
faqs.answer: The platform focuses on personalized erotic fiction: short scenes, longer multi-chapter stories and interactive role-play. It also provides character creation, plot brainstorming and editing tools, with image and video extras advertised on higher tiers.

faqs.question: Is AI Smut Writer only for adults?
faqs.answer: Yes. The service is restricted to users 18 and over and contains sexually explicit AI-generated content. Its terms prohibit content involving minors, non-consensual acts, extreme violence and illegal activity.
